Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

Position: Director of Engineering

Location: Valley Green, PA

Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. We have design, sales, and manufacturing locations globally and are currently seeking a Director of Engineering to join our Backplane OverPass Engineering team located in Etters, PA.

The Backplane OverPass Solutions Business Unit develops high-speed, high-bandwidth interconnect solutions for AI, cloud, networking, server, storage, and data-center platforms. Its portfolio includes advanced connectors, and flyover cable assemblies that move signals off traditional PCB traces to improve signal integrity, reduce loss and heat, and support next-generation system architectures. The business partners globally across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and customers to deliver scalable connectivity solutions for leading technology companies.

Responsibilities

Lead a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for product development, mechanical and electrical design, program execution, and validation.
Own the engineering lifecycle from concept through NPI to volume production.
Drive program management and cross-functional alignment across engineering, operations, quality, and sales teams.
Oversee signal integrity strategy, test development, and performance validation for high-speed interconnect products (e.g., 112G PAM4 and beyond).
Interface directly with leading AI system and hyperscale customers to define interconnect solutions optimized for their architectures.
Partner with business and product line leadership to define product roadmaps aligned with evolving AI workloads and system-level requirements.
Champion a culture of technical excellence, execution rigor, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelors or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of engineering experience in high-speed interconnect, data center hardware, or AI system development.
Deep familiarity with system-level architecture of AI clusters, including GPU-to-GPU, GPU-to-switch, and switch-to-switch connectivity.
Proven leadership in managing multi-disciplinary teams across product development, signal integrity, and testing.
Hands-on knowledge of high-speed electrical design, crosstalk mitigation, and compliance to emerging standards (e.g., PCIe, Ethernet, InfiniBand).
Strong background working with system companies (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, Intel, or hyperscalers) designing compute and networking systems for AI workloads.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering programs, meet aggressive timelines, and deliver high-quality products.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in customer-facing engagements.

Our main focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

added.description:
Job Description

Your opportunity to make a real impact and shape the future of financial services is waiting for you. Let's push the boundaries of what's possible together.

As a Senior Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within Consumer & Community Banking, you lead multiple technical areas, manage the activities of multiple departments, and collaborate across technical domains. Your expertise is applied cross-functionally to drive the adoption and implementation of technical methods within various teams and aid the firm in remaining at the forefront of industry trends, best practices, and technological advances.

Job Responsibilities

Leads multiple technology and process implementations across departments to achieve firmwide technology objectives
Directly manages multiple areas with strategic transactional focus
Sets and scales multi-department strategy for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment) to drive firmwide objectives (speed, scalability, reliability, and cost-to-serve), including portfolio-level standards for AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release governance, automated test modernization, resilience engineering, and incident response acceleration; establishes guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse.
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to drive cross-domain reuse and measurable capacity unlock outcomes across departments.
Provides leadership and high-level direction to teams while frequently overseeing employee populations across multiple platforms, divisions, and lines of business
Acts as the primary interface with senior leaders, stakeholders, and executives, driving consensus across competing objectives
Manages multiple stakeholders, complex projects, and large cross-product collaborations
Influences peer leaders and senior stakeholders across the business, product, and technology teams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience. In addition, 5+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
Deep expertise in building and operating high-throughput, resilient data platforms with strong consistency guarantees, including API and event-streaming (Kafka) architectures
Proven ability to create reusable frameworks, SDKs, or platform abstractions adopted across multiple teams and product lines
Experience developing or leading large or cross-functional teams of technologists
Demonstrated prior experience influencing across highly matrixed, complex organizations and delivering value at scale
Experience leading multi-organization adoption of agentic AI-enabled engineering operating models (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment), including defining governance (human-in-the-loop decisioning, quality gates), measurement frameworks, and secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs across teams.
Deep understanding of responsible AI risk, controls, and resiliency/security expectations at scale, with demonstrated ability to advise senior leaders on safe adoption, portfolio governance, and reuse-first strategies.
Experience leading complex projects supporting system design, testing, and operational stability
Experience with hiring, developing, and recognizing talent
Extensive practical cloud native experience

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Background in financial services or other highly regulated industries with understanding of data governance, privacy, and compliance requirements

About Us

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. added.location: WP. Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
added.description:
Fintonia Group is building a tech-enabled digital assets financial services platform, with offices in Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, combining a strong background in traditional finance with disruptive technology.

You will be joining a fun and fast-paced environment and will be working with a small team of seasoned industry professionals with experience working at top tier global investment banks and industry leaders.

The Role:

The Head of Engineering owns the design, build, and operation of the technology platform behind that business, and leads the engineering team building it. The Loan Management System (LMS) and Portfolio Management System (PMS) are in active development: the successful candidate will build them out from the ground up, accelerate delivery to launch, and then extend the platform into real-time trading and asset management.

Key Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Architecture
Own the architecture of the firm's Loan Management System (LMS) and Portfolio Management System (PMS).
Define the technical roadmap across lending, risk, and trading systems, and accelerate the current build to production launch.
Translate product specifications from the Head of Lending into scoped, sequenced delivery with committed dates.
Set engineering standards for code review, testing, and release, scaled to the consequence of the system being changed.

Security Architecture & Controls
Define and own the firm's security architecture: identity and access management, secrets handling, key management, and network segmentation across services.
Design the control framework around custody and exchange integrations: API key scoping, withdrawal permissions, and approval quorums.
Own the audit posture required for MAS review: attributable actors on every state change, immutable transaction history, and evidentiary records.
Establish security review standards for code, dependencies, and infrastructure.

Platform Delivery & Operations
Own deployment and CI/CD across staging and production: containerised services on AWS ECS/Fargate, infrastructure as code, and controlled release gates.
Own database architecture, migration discipline, and concurrency controls on all money-moving records.
Maintain uptime, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery against a four-hour recovery objective.

Trading & Asset Management Systems
Architect and lead the build of real-time trading infrastructure: venue connectivity, market data ingestion, order management, and automated execution.
Extend the platform into asset management: portfolio construction, valuation, performance measurement, and investor reporting.
Deliver live risk and position management across both the lending book and traded positions.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Contribution
Manage and grow the engineering team, currently two engineers.
Work closely with the Head of Lending on product requirements, validation rules, and delivery priorities.
Collaborate with Legal & Compliance on how contractual and regulatory obligations are encoded into system behaviour.
Partner with Operations on custody, settlement, and loan lifecycle workflows.
Report on technology delivery, risk, and security posture to the Fintonia Leadership Team (FLT).

Requirements:

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 10 years of experience building production systems, including several years leading engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience building and operating real-time trading infrastructure: order management, execution, market data, or exchange connectivity.
Proven track record defining security architecture for systems handling money or assets, including key management and privileged access controls.
Demonstrated experience building with AI coding tools, and the judgment to apply appropriate review standards to AI-assisted work.
Deep backend engineering expertise in Python or a comparable language, with hands-on ownership of deployment, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.
Production-depth PostgreSQL experience, and rigour in numerical precision for financial systems.
Experience operating within a regulated financial services environment; MAS familiarity preferred.
Experience with event-driven or event-sourced architectures preferred.
Exposure to digital asset infrastructure — custody, exchange APIs, on-chain settlement — preferred but not required.
Lending, margin, or credit domain knowledge is not required; product expertise sits with the Head of Lending.
Entrepreneurial mindset with the discipline and judgment to operate within a regulated, governance-driven firm.
Excellent communication skills — able to engage credibly with senior stakeholders, auditors, and counterparties.
